description: Returns the sum of all its arguments. Variadic: accepts any number of args. `(+)` returns 0, `(+ x)` returns x.
Subtraction. With one arg, negates: `(- x)` = `(- 0 x)`. With multiple args, left-folds subtraction.
Multiplies all arguments together. Variadic: `(*)` returns 1, `(* x)` returns x.
Division. With one arg: `(/ x)` = `(/ 1 x)`. With multiple args, left-folds division.
Modulo (remainder after division). Variadic left-fold with 2+ args.

name: min
description: Returns the minimum of its arguments. Variadic left-fold with 2+ args.

name: max
description: Returns the maximum of its arguments. Variadic left-fold with 2+ args.
Returns 1.0 if the first value is greater than the second, 0.0 otherwise.
examples: (> beat 0.5) ;; 1.0 in second half of beat

description: Returns 1.0 if the first value is less than the second, 0.0 otherwise.
examples: (< beat 0.5) ;; 1.0 in first half of beat

description: Returns 1.0 if the first value is greater than or equal to the second, 0.0 otherwise.
Returns 1.0 if the first value is less than or equal to the second, 0.0 otherwise.
Returns 1.0 if two values are equal, 0.0 otherwise.

name: not
description: Logical NOT. Returns 1.0 if the value is 0 (falsy), 0.0 otherwise.

name: and
description: Logical AND. Returns 1.0 if both values are non-zero, 0.0 otherwise.

name: or
description: Logical OR. Returns 1.0 if either value is non-zero, 0.0 otherwise.

name: sin
description: Sine function. Takes radians, returns [-1, 1].
examples: (sin (* 6.28 beat)) ;; sine wave over one beat

name: cos
description: Cosine function. Takes radians, returns [-1, 1].

name: tan
description: Tangent function. Takes radians.

name: abs
description: Absolute value.

name: floor
description: Rounds a number down to the nearest integer.

name: ceil
description: Rounds a number up to the nearest integer.

name: sqrt
description: Square root.

name: neg
description: Negate a value (multiply by -1).

name: frac
description: Fractional part of a number: `x - floor(x)`. Always in [0, 1).

name: pow
description: Raises base to a power. Note argument order: `(pow exponent base)` = base^exponent.

name: expt
description: Raises base to a power. Standard argument order: `(expt base exponent)` = base^exponent.

name: clamp
description: Constrains a value between a minimum and maximum.

name: lerp
description: Linear interpolation between two values. `(lerp a b t)` = a + (b - a) * t.

name: scale
description: Scales a value from [0, 1] to a target range. `(scale out-min out-max value)` maps value from [0,1] to [out-min, out-max].

name: usin
description: Unipolar sine: takes a phasor [0,1] and outputs a sine wave [0,1]. Equivalent to `0.5 + 0.5 * sin(x * 2π)`.

parameters.name: phasor
parameters.description: Input phasor (0-1 maps to one full cycle)

examples: (a1 (usin beat)) ;; smooth sine LFO per beat

name: ucos
description: Unipolar cosine: takes a phasor [0,1] and outputs a cosine wave [0,1]. Starts at 1.0, falls to 0, returns to 1.

parameters.name: phasor
parameters.description: Input phasor (0-1 maps to one full cycle)

name: bi-to-uni
description: Converts a bipolar value [-1, 1] to unipolar [0, 1]. Formula: `x * 0.5 + 0.5`.

name: uni-to-bi
description: Converts a unipolar value [0, 1] to bipolar [-1, 1]. Formula: `x * 2 - 1`.

name: tri
description: Triangle wave shaper. With 1 arg: symmetric triangle from phasor. With 2 args: `(tri duty phase)` — duty controls the peak position (0-1).

parameters.name: duty
parameters.description: Peak position within cycle (0 = immediate fall, 0.5 = symmetric, 1 = immediate rise)

name: sqr
description: Square wave shaper. Converts a phasor to a square wave (0 or 1). With 1 arg: 50% duty cycle. With 2 args: `(sqr duty phase)`.

parameters.name: duty
parameters.description: Pulse width (fraction of cycle that is high)

examples: (d1 (sqr beat)) ;; gate: high for first half of each beat

name: pulse
description: Pulse/gate: returns 1.0 when phase < width, 0.0 otherwise. `(pulse width phase)`.
examples: (d1 (pulse 0.1 beat)) ;; short trigger at start of beat

name: t
description: Logical transport time in seconds since last reset. Monotonically increasing during playback. Resets with transport controls.

name: dt
description: Time delta between the current sample and the previous sample, in seconds. Useful for rate-based calculations.

name: beat
description: A phasor rising from 0 to 1 over the duration of one beat (determined by BPM).

name: bar
description: A phasor rising from 0 to 1 over the duration of one bar (determined by BPM and time signature).

name: phrase
description: A phasor rising from 0 to 1 over the duration of one phrase (multiple bars).

name: section
description: A phasor rising from 0 to 1 over the duration of one section (multiple phrases).

name: beat-num
description: Integer counter of total beats elapsed (floor of continuous beat count).

name: bar-num
description: Integer counter of total bars elapsed.

name: beat-dur
description: Duration of one beat in seconds (= 60 / bpm).

name: bar-dur
description: Duration of one bar in seconds (= beat-dur × beats-per-bar).

name: bpm
description: The current tempo in beats per minute. Readable in signal context; settable via `set-bpm` in cold context.

name: beats-per-bar
description: Number of beats in one bar (time signature numerator).

name: bars-per-phrase
description: Number of bars in one phrase.

name: phrases-per-section
description: Number of phrases in one section.

name: fast
description: Speed up time for everything inside the body. All time-leaves (beat, bar, t, etc.) inside the body run faster by the given factor.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Expression whose time is sped up

name: slow
description: Slow down time for everything inside the body. All time-leaves inside the body run slower by the given factor.

name: offset
description: Shift time forward for everything inside the body. Offsets all time-leaves by the given amount. Commonly used to offset phasors: `(offset 0.5 bar)` starts the bar phasor from the halfway point.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Time offset amount (for phasors: 0-1 shifts start point)

name: loop-at
description: Loops time modulo a duration. The body's time resets every `duration` seconds.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Loop length in the time domain

name: eval-at-time
description: Evaluate body at an arbitrary time value. Replaces the time context entirely — the body sees the given time expression as `t`.

parameters.name: time-expr
parameters.description: The time value to evaluate at

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Expression to evaluate at that time

examples: (eval-at-time (* 2 t) beat) ;; beat at double real-time

name: step
description: Step sequencer: indexes a data list by a phasor. Divides the phasor range into equal steps and outputs the value at the current step. Phase defaults to `beat` if omitted.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: List/vector of values to sequence through

name: gates
description: Gate sequencer: like `step` but outputs 1 (gate on) for non-zero values and 0 (gate off) for zero values. Phase defaults to `beat` if omitted.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: List of gate values (0 = off, non-zero = on)

name: trigs
description: Trigger sequencer: like `gates` but outputs gate values directly (0-1 amplitude). Phase defaults to `beat` if omitted.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: List of trigger values (0 = off, 1-9 = amplitude levels)

name: gatesw
description: Gate sequencer with per-step pulse width control. Values 0-9 encode both gate-on and pulse width: 0 = off, 1 = shortest gate, 9 = full-length tie. Phase defaults to `beat` if omitted.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: List of gate+width values (0 = off, 1-9 = increasing pulse width)

name: euclid
description: Euclidean rhythm generator. Distributes `active` pulses as evenly as possible across `total` steps. Phase defaults to `beat` if omitted.

parameters.name: total
parameters.description: Total number of steps in the pattern

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Number of active (on) steps to distribute

name: interp
description: Linear interpolation through a list of values, treating them as a continuous envelope. Phase defaults to `beat` if omitted.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: List of values to interpolate between

parameters.name: phase
parameters.description: Position in envelope (0 = first value, 1 = last value)

name: dm
description: Demux/conditional gate: if condition is non-zero, output value; otherwise output default. `(dm condition default value)`.
examples: (dm in1 0 (usin beat)) ;; sine when input high, 0 when low

name: rpulse
description: Generates pulses at ratio-divided phasor sections. The ratios list defines relative timing divisions; a pulse fires at the start of each section. Phase defaults to `beat` if omitted.
examples: (d1 (rpulse [1 1] 0.5 bar)) ;; two equal pulses per bar

name: rstep
description: Sample-and-hold on phasor at ratio-timed points. Returns the normalised start position of the current subdivision. Phase defaults to `beat` if omitted.

name: ridx
description: Ratio-indexed steps. Divides a phasor by ratios and outputs the normalised index (i/N) of the current subdivision. Useful as a phasor for indexing other sequences with non-uniform timing. Phase defaults to `beat` if omitted.

name: rwarp
description: Remaps time through non-uniform subdivisions. Like `ridx` but produces ramps between points (continuous) rather than steps. Useful for driving `gatesw` with non-uniform timing. Phase defaults to `beat` if omitted.

name: random
description: Deterministic per-beat random value. Changes once per beat (affected by fast/slow). Returns a float in [0,1] with no args, or scaled to [lo, hi] with args.

name: index-rand
description: Deterministic random value keyed by an arbitrary index. Same index always produces the same value. Useful for creating repeatable pseudo-random patterns.

name: range
description: Creates a compile-time sequence of numbers. All arguments must be constants. `(range end)`, `(range start end)`, or `(range start end step)`.

name: if
description: Conditional: returns `then` value when condition is non-zero, `else` value otherwise. Else defaults to 0.0 if omitted.
examples: (a1 (if in1 (usin bar) 0)) ;; sine when input high

name: while
description: Signal gate: returns body value when condition is non-zero, 0.0 when condition is zero. In signal context this is NOT a loop — it's a conditional gate.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Value to pass through when gate is open

examples: (while in1 (usin beat)) ;; sine only when input high

name: let
description: Local bindings. Creates named values scoped to the body. Bindings are pairs in a vector: `[name1 val1 name2 val2 ...]`.

name: do
description: Evaluates expressions in sequence, returns the last value. Useful for grouping multiple output assignments or side-effects at top level.

name: for
description: Compile-time loop: unrolls over a collection at compile time. The collection must be a constant (literal vector or `range`). Returns the last iteration's value.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Compile-time constant collection to iterate over

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Expression to evaluate for each element

name: define
description: Creates a named cell (reactive binding). The expression is stored and recompiled into any output that references it. Redefining a cell invalidates all dependent outputs.

parameters.name: expression
parameters.description: The expression to bind (can be time-varying)

examples:
(define my-lfo (usin bar))
(a1 my-lfo) ;; uses the defined signal

name: defn
description: Defines a named function. In signal context, functions are inlined at every call site (no closures). Parameters are bound to argument expressions at compile time.

name: defs
description: Bulk define: defines multiple name/value pairs in one form. Equivalent to multiple `define` calls.

parameters.name: pairs
parameters.description: Alternating name/value pairs in a vector

name: set
description: Evaluates the expression immediately and stores the resulting numeric value. Unlike `define`, the stored value is static — it won't update reactively if dependencies change.
examples: (set snapshot bar) ;; captures bar's value at this instant

name: defstate
description: Defines a stateful accumulator cell. Stores persistent state that updates each tick. Initial value must be a literal number.

parameters.name: init
parameters.description: Initial value (must be a literal number)

parameters.name: update-expr
parameters.description: Expression computed each tick (can reference the state variable by name)

name: zeros
description: Creates a vector of zeros of the specified length. Useful for initializing sequence data.

name: get-expr
description: Retrieves the stored source expression for a named cell. Useful for inspection/debugging.

name: prev
description: Reads the previous tick's output value for a named output. Enables feedback between outputs.

parameters.name: output-name
parameters.description: Name of an output (a1-a8, d1-d8, s1-s8)

name: integrate
description: Stateful accumulator: adds `rate × dt` each tick. Wraps around — use `clamp` or `%` to bound. Keyword `:id` for explicit state identity.

name: phasor
description: Free-running phasor at a given frequency (Hz). Ramps from 0 to 1 continuously. Independent of beat/bar timing. Keyword `:phase` sets initial phase, `:id` for state identity.

name: lfo
description: Multi-waveform oscillator. Keyword `:wave` selects shape (`:sin`, `:tri`, `:saw`, `:sqr`). Keyword `:pw` sets pulse width for square. Defaults to sine. Output range [0, 1].

name: tri-osc
description: Triangle oscillator shorthand. Equivalent to `(lfo freq :wave :tri)`.

name: saw
description: Sawtooth oscillator shorthand. Equivalent to `(lfo freq :wave :saw)`.

name: sqr-osc
description: Square oscillator shorthand. Equivalent to `(lfo freq :wave :sqr)`.

name: slew
description: Slew rate limiter: smoothly transitions towards target at a maximum rate (units per second). Useful for portamento, smoothing, lag.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: Maximum rate of change (units per second)

name: one-pole
description: First-order low-pass filter (one-pole). Smooths the input signal with a given cutoff coefficient.

name: env-follow
description: Asymmetric envelope follower. Rises quickly (attack) and falls slowly (release). Defaults: attack=10, release=5.

name: sah
description: Sample and hold: captures the input value on each rising edge of the trigger signal. Holds the value until the next trigger.

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.description: Trigger signal (samples on rising edge: 0→non-zero transition)

examples: (a1 (sah ain1 (sqr beat))) ;; sample CV each beat

name: noise
description: Deterministic white noise [-1, 1]. Changes every sample. Uses a hash counter for reproducibility.

name: toggle
description: T-flip-flop: toggles between 0 and 1 on each rising edge of the trigger.
examples: (d1 (toggle in1)) ;; toggle output on button press

name: count
description: Rising-edge counter: increments by 1 on each rising edge of the trigger. Optional `:reset` trigger resets to 0.

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.description: Signal to count rising edges of

parameters.name: :reset
parameters.description: Reset trigger (resets count to 0 on rising edge)

examples: (count in1 :reset (sqr bar)) ;; count inputs, reset each bar

name: live-edit
description: Runtime-adjustable parameter. Creates a value that can be modified from the editor UI without re-evaluating. Keyword options control range, name, and step size.

name: input
description: Read a hardware input by channel number. Channel must be a constant: 0=in1, 1=in2, 2=ain1, 3=ain2.

name: in1
description: Digital input 1. Returns 0 or 1.

name: in2
description: Digital input 2. Returns 0 or 1.

name: ain1
description: Analog/CV input 1. Returns a continuous value (typically 0 to 1).

name: ain2
description: Analog/CV input 2. Returns a continuous value (typically 0 to 1).

name: a1
description: Assign a signal expression to analog output 1 (through 8). The expression is compiled into a signal graph and evaluated every tick to produce a continuous voltage.

name: d1
description: Assign a signal expression to digital output 1 (through 8). The expression is evaluated every tick; non-zero = high, zero = low.

name: s1
description: Assign a signal expression to serial output 1 (through 8). Values are streamed over USB serial as binary messages. Can be decoded by the editor for MIDI output etc.

name: set-bpm
description: Set the sequencer tempo in beats per minute.

name: set-time-sig
description: Set the time signature (beats per bar and subdivision).

name: useq-clear
description: Clears all outputs and resets the signal engine. All running programs stop immediately.

name: useq-play
description: Start/resume playback. Time begins advancing.

name: useq-pause
description: Pause playback. Time stops advancing but outputs hold their current values.

name: useq-stop
description: Stop playback and reset time to zero.

name: useq-rewind
description: Reset time offset to zero without stopping playback.

name: useq-set-time-offset
description: Set the absolute time offset in seconds.

name: useq-nudge-time
description: Nudge the time offset by a delta (positive = forward, negative = backward).

name: lambda
description: Creates an anonymous function. Must be defined with `defn` and called by name in signal context — inline anonymous lambdas in signal expressions will produce an error suggesting this.
examples:
;; In cold context, lambdas work directly:
(define scale-fn (fn [x] (* x 0.5)))
